3.name: third person
3.plain: anyone or anything else: he, she, it, they

PRS.name: present
PRS.plain: happening now, or the tense-neutral form of a participle or infinitive

NOM.name: nominative
NOM.plain: the case of the doer, and of what a thing is said to be

ACC.name: accusative
ACC.plain: the case of the thing acted on, and of the goal of motion

Q.name: question particle
Q.plain: a small word that turns a statement into a question

GEN.name: genitive
GEN.plain: the case that hangs one noun on another: of, 's

DAT.name: dative
DAT.plain: the case of the person concerned: to, for

ABL.name: ablative
ABL.plain: the case of source, tool and setting: from, with, in, by

VOC.name: vocative
VOC.plain: the form used to call or address someone

LOC.name: locative
LOC.plain: a rare case meaning at a place

REFL.name: reflexive
REFL.plain: refers back to the subject: himself, herself, themselves

INF.name: infinitive
INF.plain: the form that names the action: to love

IPFV.name: imperfect
IPFV.plain: a past action seen as going on or repeated

PLUP.name: pluperfect
PLUP.plain: an action complete before another past moment: had loved

FUTP.name: future perfect
FUTP.plain: an action that will be complete before a future moment: will have loved

PASS.name: passive
PASS.plain: the subject undergoes the action instead of doing it

PTCP.name: participle
PTCP.plain: an adjective made from a verb

DEP.name: deponent
DEP.plain: a passive ending on a verb whose meaning is active

SBJV.name: subjunctive
SBJV.plain: the mood of what is wished, intended or imagined, not stated as fact

ADV.name: adverb ending
ADV.plain: turns an adjective into a word describing how

REL.name: relative
REL.plain: the word that opens a clause describing a noun: who, which

GER.name: gerund
GER.plain: a noun made from a verb: loving

GERV.name: gerundive
GERV.plain: an adjective made from a verb meaning needing to be done

SUP.name: supine
SUP.plain: a fossil verbal noun in -um or -ū

terms.ending: The final, changeable piece of a word that says what job it is doing (lat-00-02).
terms.stem: The part of a word that stays the same while the ending changes (lat-00-02).
terms.gloss: The line under an example that labels each piece of each word (lat-00-02).
terms.fusional: Built so that one ending carries several meanings at once (lat-00-02).
terms.restored pronunciation: The pronunciation of educated Romans of the classical period, reconstructed from ancient evidence (lat-01-01).
terms.macron: A bar over a vowel marking it as long: ā (lat-01-01).
terms.diphthong: Two vowel sounds glided together inside one syllable, as in ae and au (lat-01-02).
terms.stop: A consonant made by blocking the air completely and releasing it: p, t, c, b, d, g (lat-01-03).
terms.syllable: A beat of a word, built round one vowel or diphthong (lat-01-03).
terms.light syllable: A syllable with a short vowel that is not closed by a consonant (lat-01-03).
terms.heavy syllable: A syllable with a long vowel or diphthong, or closed by a consonant (lat-01-03).
terms.stress: The extra force that makes one syllable of a word stand out (lat-01-04).
terms.penult: The second-from-last syllable of a word (lat-01-04).
terms.antepenult: The third-from-last syllable of a word (lat-01-04).
terms.orthography: A language's spelling system and conventions (lat-01-05).
terms.apex: A mark Romans sometimes wrote over a long vowel in inscriptions (lat-01-05).
